```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s09_data_source_map/"
```

# Create a map showing data collection locations in Madagascar

```{r}
target <- c("Madagascar", "Mozambique", "Comoros", "Mauritius", "Seychelles", "Mayotte", "United Republic of Tanzania", "Malawi", "Zimbabwe", "South Africa", "Eswatini", "Zambia", "Lesotho", "Somalia", "Kenya", "Ethiopia", "Uganda", "Rwanda", "Burundi", "Djibouti", "Eritrea", "South Sudan", "Botswana", "Namibia", "Angola", "Democratic Republic of the Congo", "Central African Republic", "Republic of the Congo", "Equatorial Guinea", "Cameroon")

# @TODO "Reunion" "Equatorial Guinea"!!
Madagascar_inset <- ne_countries(country = target, type = "map_units", scale = 50)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar_inset) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1000000, 1800000), ylim = c(1, 2000000)) + # Laborde projection, commonly used for Madagascar
  theme_light()
```


```{r}
# Dissolve map country boundaries into a single geometry
Madagascar_dissolved <- Madagascar_inset %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf() # Convert back to sf object
```


```{r}
# Africa
africa <- ne_countries(continent = "Africa", scale = 50, returnclass = "sf") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = africa) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1500000, 4800000), ylim = c(-1500000, 4500000)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA))
```


```{r}
# kml_data <- sf::st_read(dsn = "../data/raw/data_input/Data_with_pierron.kml")
# kml_data <- sf::st_transform(kml_data, crs = 29702)
#

# 
# kml_data <- kml_data %>%
#   mutate(
#     x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
#     y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]

kml_data <- readRDS("../data/raw/data_input/sampling_locations_with_pierron.rds")


ours <- rep(0, 5)
pierron <- rep(1, 9)
sample <- c(ours, pierron)
kml_data$sample <- sample

labels_data <- kml_data %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y),
    geometry = st_centroid(st_union(geometry)) # Optional: Keeps geometry if needed
  )

# Replace kml_data$Name == "Sakalava_Tsimihety" with "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
kml_data$Name[kml_data$Name == "Sakalava_Tsimihety"] <- "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
# Replace kmldata$Name == "Diego" with "Diego Mixed"
kml_data$Name[kml_data$Name == "Diego"] <- "Diego Mixed"

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar_dissolved) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data), aes(shape = factor(sample)), size = 1) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1000000, 1800000), ylim = c(1, 2000000), expand = FALSE) + # Laborde projection, commonly used for Madagascar
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), labels = c("Our sample", "From literature")) +
  labs(shape = NULL) +
  # geom_text(data = kml_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), size = 3, hjust = -0.3)
  geom_text(data = labels_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), size = 3, hjust = -0.3) +
  # geom_text_repel(data = labels_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), max.overlaps = 10, force = 200)+
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)


ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_map_labels.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
kml_data <- kml_data[order(kml_data$Name), ]

kml_data$shape <- c(1, 3, 7, 15, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 19, 21, 23)

main_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar_dissolved) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data), aes(shape = Name, color = Name, fill = Name), size = 2) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1000000, 1800000), ylim = c(1, 2000000), expand = FALSE) + # Laborde projection, commonly used for Madagascar
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 3, 7, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23)) +
  labs(shape = NULL) +
  # geom_text(data = labels_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), size = 3, hjust = -0.3)+
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL, shape = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  guides() +
  theme(  legend.position = c(0.85, 0.65),
    #legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

main_map
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_map_pca_symbols.jpg"), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Create an inset

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(cowplot)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

africa <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", continent = c("Africa", "Asia", "Europe"), returnclass = "sf") %>% st_union()
madagascar_outline <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", country = "Madagascar", returnclass = "sf")

inset_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = africa, fill = "gray90", color = "gray60") +
  geom_sf(data = madagascar_outline, fill = "gray60", color = "gray60") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-15, 130), ylim = c(-40, 40)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5))

# --- Combine main map and inset ---
final_plot <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(main_map) +
  draw_plot(inset_map, x = 0.55, y = 0.71, width = 0.25, height = 0.25) # adjust position/size

final_plot

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_map_pca_symbols_inset.jpg"), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


# Extra map for poster

```{r}
# filter kml data to only betsileo, merina, betsimisaraka, and sakalava
kml_data_subset <- kml_data[kml_data$Name %in% c("Betsileo", "Merina", "Betsimisaraka", "Sakalava"), ]
# rename "sakalava" to "Sakalava/Tsimihety
kml_data_subset$Name[kml_data_subset$Name == "Sakalava"] <- "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar_dissolved) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data_subset), aes(shape = Name, color = Name, fill = Name), size = 2) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1000000, 1800000), ylim = c(1, 2000000), expand = FALSE) + # Laborde projection, commonly used for Madagascar
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 3, 15, 19)) +
  labs(shape = NULL) +
  # geom_text(data = labels_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), size = 3, hjust = -0.3)+
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Betsileo" = "#1B9E77", "Merina" = "#7570B3", "Betsimisaraka" = "#D95F02", "Sakalava/Tsimihety" = "#E7298A")) +
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Betsileo" = "#1B9E77", "Merina" = "#7570B3", "Betsimisaraka" = "#D95F02", "Sakalava/Tsimihety" = "#E7298A")) +
  guides()

```




# Data currently merged in: Malagasy, 1000 Genomes, Borneo, Sumba

```{r}
# Get all African countries
africa_eurasia <- ne_countries(continent = c("Africa", "Asia"), scale = 50, returnclass = "sf") # %>% st_union() %>% st_as_sf()

# Specify countries to highlight and assign colors
highlighted_countries <- africa_eurasia %>%
  mutate(fill_color = case_when(
    name %in% c("Madagascar", "Kenya", "Nigeria", "Sierra Leone", "The Gambia", "China", "Vietnam", "Pakistan", "Bangladesh", "Indonesia") ~ "highlight", # Countries to color
    TRUE ~ "base" # Default color for other countries
  ))


# Plot current data
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = highlighted_countries, aes(fill = fill_color)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("highlight" = "#FFDBBB", "base" = "gray80")) +
  # coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1500000,4800000), ylim = c(-1500000,4500000)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA))
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s09_data_source_map.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  res_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)

```
